evidence: derived from the MF-01 production measured in this repository and from the WF-05 visual DNA; prescriptive values are labelled normative

world.accent_roles: amber = identity and data, blood = danger, signal = safe/correct answer, mist = secondary text and sources
world.subject: the plate's subject is lit and sharp; the environment is soft and darker — this IS the depth cue the engine reads
world.composition: one dominant subject, breathing room, hierarchy before decoration
world.background: cinematic night/forest field, deep teal shadows, warm bone highlights, far-plane atmospheric separation up to 0.22

type.identity_font: Montserrat VF (wght 900, variable axes verified by ink coverage 4.86 -> 42.91)
type.screen_text: one hot word per headline; kicker -> dominant claim -> connective phrase
type.case: uppercase for claims and data; sentence case only in sources

depth.saliency: focus 0.62 + tone-deviation 0.24 + saturation 0.14 (a darkness prior inverts on this style — see T01)

constraints: no third-party footage, music or overlays
no caption pill or karaoke band
no unsupported comparison in a chart
no claim on screen without a source
no effect that does not decay
no depth boundary through a subject
no approval recorded from intention rather than measurement
